'''Jerome Harold Friedman''' (born December 29, 1939) is an American statistician, consultant and Professor of Statistics at [[Stanford University]], known for his contributions in the field of [[statistics]] and [[data mining]].<ref name= "stanford">[https://statistics.stanford.edu/people/jerome-h-friedman Jerome H. Friedman] Professor of Statistics. Accessed 18 July 2017.</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Chow |first=Rony |date=2021-06-03 |title=Jerome H. Friedman: Applying Statistics to Data and Machine Learning |url=https://www.historyofdatascience.com/jerome-friedman-applying-statistics-to-data-and-machine-learning/ |access-date=2023-01-04 |website=History of Data Science |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Friedman studied at [[Chico State College]] for two years before transferring to the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in 1959, where he received his AB in Physics in 1962, and his PhD in High Energy Particle Physics in 1967.<ref name="Vita 2012">[http://www-stat.stanford.edu/~jhf/ftp/vita.pdf Jerome H. Friedman] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130608123739/http://www-stat.stanford.edu/~jhf/ftp/vita.pdf |date=2013-06-08 }} Vita December 2012, at stat.stanford.edu. Accessed 18 July 2017.</ref><ref>[http://genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=40881 Jerome Harold Friedman]. Mathematics Genealogy Project</ref>

In 1968 he started his academic career as research physicist at the [[Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory]]. In 1972 he started at Stanford University as leader of the Computation Research Group at the [[Stanford Linear Accelerator Center]], where he would participate until 2003. In the year 1976–77 he was a visiting scientist at [[CERN]] in Geneva. From 1981 to 1984 he was visiting professor at the University of California, Berkeley. In 1982 he was appointed Professor of Statistics at [[Stanford University]].<ref name="Vita 2012"/>

In 1984 he was elected as a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]].<ref>[http://www.amstat.org/awards/fellowslist.cfm View/Search Fellows of the ASA] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160616161612/https://www.amstat.org/awards/fellowslist.cfm |date=2016-06-16 }}, accessed 2016-10-29.</ref>
In 2002 he was awarded the SIGKDD Innovation Award by the [[Association for Computing Machinery]] (ACM).<ref>[http://www.kdd.org/awards/view/2002-sigkdd-innovation-award-dr.-jerome-h.-friedman Dr. Jerome H. Friedman] awarded the SIGKDD Innovation Award, 2002.</ref> In 2010 he was elected as a member of the [[List of members of the National Academy of Sciences (Applied mathematical sciences)|National Academy of Sciences (Applied mathematical sciences)]].

== Publications ==
Friedman has authored and co-authored many publications in the field of data-mining including "nearest neighbor classification, logistical regressions, and high dimensional data analysis. His primary research interest is in the area of machine learning."<ref name= "stanford"/>  A selection:
*{{cite journal |last1=Friedman |first1=Jerome H. |first2=John W. |last2=Tukey |authorlink2=John W. Tukey |name-list-style=amp |title=A projection pursuit algorithm for exploratory data analysis |journal=[[IEEE Transactions on Computers]] |volume=23 |issue=9 |year=1974 |pages=881–890 |doi=10.1109/T-C.1974.224051 |osti=1442925 |s2cid=7997450 }}
*{{cite journal |last1=Friedman |first1=Jerome H. |first2=Werner |last2=Stuetzle |name-list-style=amp |title=Projection pursuit regression |journal=[[Journal of the American Statistical Association]] |volume=76 |issue=376 |year=1981 |pages=817–823 |doi=10.1080/01621459.1981.10477729 |osti=1445517 }}
*{{cite journal |last=Friedman |first=Jerome H. |title=Multivariate adaptive regression splines |journal=[[Annals of Statistics]] |year=1991 |volume=19 |issue=1 |pages=1–67 |jstor=2241837 |citeseerx=10.1.1.382.970 |doi=10.1214/aos/1176347963}}
*{{cite journal |last=Friedman |first=Jerome H. |title=Greedy function approximation: a gradient boosting machine |journal=Annals of Statistics |year=2001 |volume=29 |issue=5 |pages=1189–1232 |jstor=2699986 |doi=10.1214/aos/1013203451|doi-access=free }}
